jobs.title: Junior Risk Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description:
We are seeking a motivated Junior Risk Analyst to support the identification, assessment, and monitoring of business and financial risks.
You will assist in analyzing risk data, preparing reports, and helping ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
Responsibilities:
Assist in identifying, assessing, and monitoring operational and financial risks.
Analyze risk data and prepare reports for management review.
Support the development and implementation of risk management policies and procedures.
Conduct risk assessments and document findings.
Monitor compliance with internal controls and regulatory requirements.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to address risk-related issues.
Maintain accurate risk documentation and support audit activities.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Risk Management, or related field preferred.
Previous experience in risk analysis, finance, compliance, or related roles is an advantage.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel, and data analysis tools.
Excellent communication and organizational abilities.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines.
High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
Benefits:
Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
Supportive work environment with mentorship opportunities.
Access to training, certifications, and professional development programs.
Opportunities for career growth in risk management and financial analysis.
Work-life balance with flexible or hybrid scheduling options.
